draft.subject: Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer role at SPAICE
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied for the Robotics and Embedded Systems Engineer role at SPAICE. Navigation that keeps working when GNSS does not is only as good as the hardware and software underneath it.

That underneath part is what I build. For my capstone I took a robotic arm from loose parts to a working system, with vision models running on a Jetson, sensors wired and debugged at the bench, and the software running as a service that restarts itself. It worked reliably in every test. Before that I wrote firmware at the bare metal level on STM32 and designed my own circuit boards. The role asks for hardware, low level software and edge AI in one person, and I have done all three hands on.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
draft.hook_used: outcome level: company mission (navigation without GNSS) tied to dependable hardware; no specific personal hook
